CSV format and supported fields

Required: name. Optional: category, city, capacity, minGuests, priceLow, priceHigh, pricing, tags, sourceUrl, notes, availableDates, moods. Separate tags and moods with |. Mood values: cozy, outdoor, social, coastal, classic, food, casual, celebrate, private. Categories: venue, catering, photography, other. Pricing: flat, person, hour.

About the sourcing desk

An early project, built with Codex.

This tool helps you turn venue research into a source-linked shortlist for small gatherings in San Diego. The permanent name and identity are still being developed.

Matching and text extraction use local rules. You review the source details and confirm the supplier’s quote and availability. No automated outreach or booking is performed.

Your listings stay in this browser. Export a backup to keep them portable. The eleven starter leads come from official pages checked October 20, 2026. Fictional demo data is separate.
